items.headline: Big Charlotte employer taps outsider as new CEO: 'Confident he is the right leader'
items.snippet: Albemarle prepares to reopen a dormant 1,200-acre lithium mine outside of Charlotte, which recently completed the necessary federal permitting process. Albemarle reported net sales of $1.7 billion in the second quarter ending June 30, up 31% year-over-year.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $161 from $189 at Morgan Stanley
items.snippet: Morgan Stanley analyst Vincent Andrews lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $161 from $189 and keeps an Equal Weight rating on the shares. Lithium prices have come off this cycle's peak.
